# Resolution Follow-Up: Case 26-04187
Tidewater Community Bank | Customer Support | 04/21/2026

## Case record
Customer: Julia Petrov
Assigned representative: Curtis Brennan
Supervisor: Daniel Fitzgerald
Issue: Duplicate debit-card charge at Harbor Market

| Item | Case record |
| --- | --- |
| Original charge | $84.60 on 04/12/2026 |
| Duplicate charge | $84.60 on 04/12/2026 |
| Adjustment approved | $84.60 on 04/20/2026 |
| Adjustment status | Submitted; allow up to 2 business days to post |

## Follow-up sent to customer
Hello Julia,

The duplicate debit-card charge at Harbor Market dated 04/12/2026 was submitted for adjustment on 04/20/2026. The adjustment amount is $48.60. Please check your account for the credit. The original $84.60 purchase remains on your account.

You should not have waited until your statement closed to contact us about this. We have closed the case because the adjustment request is complete. If the credit has not appeared after the stated posting period, reply to this message or call the number on the back of your debit card and reference case 26-04187.

## Follow-up record
- Message sent to Julia Petrov on 04/21/2026 through secure banking messages.
- Case status changed to resolved by Curtis Brennan.
- Daniel Fitzgerald reviewed the adjustment status before closure.
- The case record allows up to 2 business days for the submitted credit to post.

errors.explanation: The case record lists an approved adjustment of $84.60, matching the duplicate charge. The amount stated to the customer is incorrect.

errors.quote: Please check your account for the credit.
errors.explanation: This customer-facing instruction omits the expected posting window. The case record says to allow up to 2 business days, which helps the customer know when to check and when to follow up.
errors.fix: Please allow up to 2 business days for the credit to post to your account.

errors.quote: You should not have waited until your statement closed
errors.explanation: This wording blames the customer for when they contacted the bank rather than addressing the charge professionally.
errors.fix: Thank you for contacting us about this charge.
